meta_title: Not a WizCommerce Alternative: Keep It, Add Voice Ordering
meta_desc: Keep WizCommerce and add spoken orders for accounts that still send scans. Buyers approve each line, so less needs reading. A WizCommerce alternative that adds.

hero.h1: Not A WizCommerce Alternative: Keep It, Add Voice
hero.lead: Get orders as a list of items the kitchen has already checked. VoiceOrder Solutions sits alongside WizCommerce: your customers say their order into our app, pick from their own guide, and approve each line before it goes. WizCommerce's AI keeps reading the scans and spreadsheets still arriving.

stats.label: Off an order that would have been phoned
Is the first order for most kitchens

problem.h2: What sends distributors looking for an alternative to WizCommerce
problem.lead: WizCommerce runs sales through reps, online, EDI and marketplaces in one AI platform. It has a storefront, a CRM, payments and real food and beverage features. None of that is the problem. The hunt for a WizCommerce competitor usually starts with the checking your team does, and that is one small thing to fix.

cards.h3: Orders read by AI still need checking
cards.body: Their own description includes a final review step for your team before orders go into the ERP, which is the honest way to build it. It still leaves you asking: did the AI read it correctly, and if not, did your team catch it?
A tool that reads handwritten sheets and voice notes stays busy because kitchens keep sending them. The pile only gets smaller when some of those kitchens start sending something else.

cards.h3: Pulling a suite out to fix one step
cards.body: Store, CRM, payments, quoting and catalog imagery come as one product family. Taking all of it out because some kitchens still fax in handwriting would be a great deal of change for a small gain.

features.h2: What a WizCommerce alternative can add without replacing it

rows.h3: Spoken straight into order lines, not a voice note
rows.body: A chef says what is short and the items appear from that account's guide, already against your codes and your prices. The buyer sees each line as it appears and fixes it before sending, so nobody at your end pieces the order together afterwards.
bullets: The person who placed it approves the list
Spoken in the cooler or the office, at any hour
Runs on their own iOS or Android phone, with no device from you
Saves 20 to 30 minutes compared with the same order by phone
Nobody writes up a reorder from an account on the app, so the reps get that time to sell

rows.h3: A short list built from what you sell them
rows.body: Every account picks from the items it actually buys, with your codes and the price you set for that customer. Orders arrive in your own items and codes, because each line is picked from that customer's guide.
bullets: Every line drawn from their guide
The catalog and the pricing stay yours to set
Edit a guide once and the next order already has it
Saved as they go if the cook gets pulled away

rows.h3: Delivered the way your office already takes it
rows.body: The order leaves as an email carrying a PDF, Excel or Word file, or goes straight into your ERP over the API, over EDI, or into QuickBooks. You do not have to remove any software first.
bullets: Addressed to a named rep, or to the purchasing desk
Over EDI, the API or QuickBooks, nobody on your team retypes it
Its own number, with the date and time it was sent
Picking, billing and delivery carry on unchanged

rows.h3: Stock on view as the orders come through
rows.body: VoiceOrder Solutions carries real-time inventory visibility tied to order activity, and the catalog updates as stock levels change. It does not replace your stock system: that stays in charge, and a demo shows how the levels connect.
bullets: Across the whole catalog, not just the quick movers
Fewer stockout surprises on a late, heavy order
Stock numbers come from the system you count with today
No counting and no buying happens on our side

cards.h2: Running WizCommerce and VoiceOrder Solutions together
cards.lead: Running both is a perfectly sensible outcome, because we are not a WizCommerce replacement. Our app moves some accounts off sending paperwork at all. Anything still arriving as a scan or a spreadsheet keeps being read by WizCommerce's AI. For many distributors that is what a WizCommerce alternative amounts to.

items.h3: Less to check at your end
items.body: Accounts on the app send lines they have already checked, not a note to decode. The WizCommerce AI still reads everything else it handles today.

items.h3: Quotes, payments and the store stay put
items.body: None of that is on offer here and none of it is affected. We hand over a finished order and do not touch what your other software does with it.

items.h3: Point it at the accounts that phone most
items.body: Buyers who already self-serve in the storefront can stay there. Begin with a handful of the kitchens that call the desk, and leave every other arrangement exactly where it is.

midcta.h3: See what lands on the desk
midcta.body: Twenty minutes. A buyer speaks, the lines come up from their guide, and what reaches you is a finished, itemized order.

steps.h2: Three steps, and no IT project
steps.lead: You hand over the guides, we load them and set up each account, and the kitchens take it from there.

items.body: A spreadsheet is enough. Items and the price per account land in one admin screen, against the codes you already use.
Accounts are opened for you, and the kitchen downloads the app. Most will have sent something in before the day ends.
It arrives approved by the customer, numbered, timed and in a format your desk can use.

items.q: Is a WizCommerce alternative the only way to get spoken orders?
items.a: No. You can keep WizCommerce and bring us in for the accounts who prefer talking an order through to writing one. Everything their platform does now carries on. The difference is that some orders arrive already itemized, so there is less for WizCommerce's AI and your team to read.

items.q: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than WizCommerce?
items.a: Not at what they are built for: reading a handwritten sheet, quoting an inquiry, running a store, customer records or payments. We do none of it. Where we are stronger is one step, an order the buyer builds and approves, so your team is not left decoding a message. That is a reason to run us next to their platform rather than instead of it.

They do: voice notes are on the list of what WizCommerce's AI assistant reads, alongside scans and handwriting. So a WizCommerce alternative pitched on voice alone would be wrong. The difference is when the order gets built. Their AI works out what a voice message said after it is sent. In our app, speaking creates the order lines, and the buyer approves them before anything is sent.

items.q: Is WizCommerce linked to VoiceOrder Solutions in any way?
items.a: No. There is nothing between them, and each company supports only its own product. Each sends its orders into your own system separately: theirs through their ERP connections, ours by email or straight into your system. Neither one routes through the other.

items.q: Will storefront buyers need a second way to order?
items.a: Only if you choose to give them one. Our app is for any kitchen that still phones, emails a scan or sends a spreadsheet. Be clear on one limit: a call or a voicemail to your desk gets no order number from us, no timestamp and no stock update. Only orders placed in the app do.

items.q: How fast could spoken orders be running?
items.a: Most distributors have the app live in 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens manage a first order that day. Nothing in WizCommerce has to change, so the platform keeps running while your first few accounts start speaking orders.

items.q: How is pricing handled if we keep both?
items.a: We quote per distributor and publish nothing, and they quote their platform too. The one price list they publish is for their AI photo product, which has its own page and tiers. Keeping WizCommerce means the only new cost is our app, and a quote from us covers that.

items.q: Where do the WizCommerce details on this page come from?
items.a: The WizCommerce facts above were checked at wizcommerce.com, dated 10 October 2026: the product family, the assistant's own list of what it reads, the review step and their industry pages. We do not repeat their performance numbers, which are theirs to stand behind. Anything that has moved since is a mistake at our end.

mainCta.body: Twenty minutes, one spoken order, from the kitchen to your inbox.
